scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

visual_review.method: All258 output thumbnails,25 larger whole-frame samples,5 face samples and all23 boundary/overlap samples at each of3 joins (all18 dissolve frames per join) viewed. Native source spot checks recorded separately. No assistant continuous normal-speed playback.
visual_review.single_source_findings: Recognizable face and readable locked wardrobe in sampled intervals; no gross instantaneous face/clothing/hand/bag/background morph observed.0black candidates;258 frames decoded. Does not certify native contact or exact architecture every frame.

join_findings.A1_A2: Standing/seated body scale and position differ; visible double heads and bench outlines. Retains previously direction-accepted first-look cut.
join_findings.A2_B1: Seated head/waist focus closer than full→medium, but size, x-position and bench/window viewpoint differ; visible face/body overlap. Not an invisible change.
join_findings.B1_B2: Seated/standing scale differs and viewing direction changes; visible larger/smaller double head/body during0.75s overlap. Comfort requires whole-film viewing.
